projects.title: AgentFlow: Multi-Agent Task Orchestration Framework
projects.description: A multi-agent orchestration framework built with LangChain, MCP tool integrations, and FastAPI async APIs, load-tested for 50+ concurrent agent sessions with sub-200ms task dispatch latency.
features: Built LangChain-based multi-agent task orchestration with MCP tool integrations
Exposed async FastAPI endpoints for low-latency task dispatch
Load-tested 50+ concurrent agent sessions with sub-200ms dispatch latency
Implemented Redis vector memory for low-latency in-session retrieval
Used pgvector for durable long-term cross-session memory
Improved task completion accuracy by 31% over a stateless baseline
projects.technologies: Python, LangChain, FastAPI, Redis, Docker, MCP, pgvector
projects.fullDescription:
AgentFlow is a multi-agent task orchestration framework for coordinating agent sessions, MCP-backed tools, and memory-aware task execution. It combines LangChain agents with FastAPI async APIs, Redis vector memory, and pgvector-backed durable context.

Key outcomes:
- Load-tested to 50+ concurrent agent sessions
- Kept task dispatch latency under 200ms in Locust benchmarks
- Implemented low-latency Redis vector memory for active sessions
- Added pgvector long-term memory for durable cross-session retrieval
- Improved task completion accuracy by 31% over a stateless baseline on a 1,000-task benchmark suite

projects.title: SmartPipe: Real-Time ML Data Pipeline
projects.description: A streaming ML data pipeline that ingests 50K events/sec with Kafka and Spark Streaming, then automates feature store refreshes through Apache Airflow DAGs.
features: Designed a streaming ML pipeline ingesting 50K events/sec
Used Kafka and Spark Streaming for real-time event processing
Stored pipeline data in AWS S3 for downstream model workflows
Automated feature store refreshes with Apache Airflow DAGs
Benchmarked streaming architecture against an equivalent batch baseline
Reduced data-to-model feedback loop from 6 hours to 22 minutes
projects.technologies: Python, Kafka, Spark Streaming, AWS S3, Apache Airflow
projects.fullDescription:
SmartPipe is an end-to-end real-time ML data pipeline designed for fast feedback between streaming data and model workflows. It uses Kafka and Spark Streaming for high-throughput ingestion, AWS S3 for storage, and Apache Airflow for automated feature refresh.

Key outcomes:
- Ingested 50K events/sec in streaming benchmarks
- Automated feature store refresh with zero manual intervention
- Compared streaming and batch baselines on identical datasets
- Reduced data-to-model feedback from 6 hours to 22 minutes
- Documented benchmark scripts for reproducible evaluation

projects.title: DistributedKV: Fault-Tolerant Key-Value Store
projects.description: A distributed key-value store built from scratch in Python with Raft consensus, gRPC client APIs, and chaos-style validation across simulated node failures and network delays.
features: Implemented Raft leader election, log replication, and snapshotting
Maintained linearizable reads and writes across a 3-node cluster
Designed a gRPC client interface with retries and leader redirects
Validated behavior under simulated network partitions
Ran 500+ chaos test iterations with random failures and network delays
projects.fullDescription:
DistributedKV is a fault-tolerant key-value store built from scratch in Python to explore correctness, consensus, and resilient client behavior. It implements the Raft consensus algorithm with leader election, log replication, snapshotting, and a gRPC API.

Key outcomes:
- Maintained linearizable reads and writes across a 3-node cluster
- Implemented leader election, log replication, and snapshotting
- Added gRPC client retries and leader-redirect logic
- Validated correctness with Jepsen-style chaos tests
- Ran 500+ random node failure and network delay test iterations
